_comment: Planned CEQL filter for the listAadGroups1 connector node in CeqlWhereTest flow. Run the configure command below after binding a live IS connection.

filterField.name: displayName
filterField.description: The display name of the group.

configureCommand: uip maestro flow node configure CeqlWhereTest.flow listAadGroups1 --detail '{"connectionId": "<CONNECTION_ID>", "folderKey": "<FOLDER_KEY>", "method": "GET", "endpoint": "/groups", "filter": {"groupOperator": 0, "index": 0, "filters": [{"id": "displayName", "operator": "Equals", "value": {"value": "active", "rawString": "\"active\"", "isLiteral": true}}], "groups": []}}' --output json
notes: The 'where' parameter has design.component='FilterBuilder' — pass the filter tree via --detail.filter, not as a raw queryParameters.where string.
The CLI compiles the tree to CEQL: displayName = 'active' (runtime side) and also persists the tree under essentialConfiguration.savedFilterTrees.where (design-time side for Studio Web round-trip).
Replace <PLACEHOLDER_CONNECTION_ID> and <PLACEHOLDER_FOLDER_KEY> with values from: uip is connections list uipath-microsoft-azureactivedirectory --all-folders --output json
The flow will NOT pass 'uip maestro flow validate' until node configure is run — this is expected per the No-Live-Tenant pattern.
